item.title: New J2ME Software Archive Search — via awesome-j2me
item.description: Search interface for the "New" J2ME software archive, with filename and MIDlet metadata searches as well as exact CRC32/SHA-1/SHA-256 lookups. Most importantly, it provides links to individual file downloads from the Internet Archive.
